question: Within a 140 kilometers distance, where can I find a restaurant on the path toward IDESST Sausalito Portuguese Cultural Center, Sausalito, CA from the View Lounge, San Francisco, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.489459 37.860625)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, 140000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
